model_output.verdict: A senior outpatient physical therapist with patient volume, program work and clinical results made clear.
write_up: Your resume is strong: it shows an outpatient orthopedic physical therapist who treats patients, builds programs and mentors newer therapists. At North Loop Sports Rehab and Lakes Regional Hospital Outpatient Clinic, you give a recruiter a concrete picture of the patients and work in each role.
The return-to-run line is a great model: you built the program and say how many patients completed it. Your Minnesota license, specialties and daily patient volume are easy to find, too.

The one detail I'd add is how the patient-reported function scores were measured. Your resume isn't likely to be what holds you back; the match with a clinic's patients and competition for the role matter, too.
